meta.name: Payment order (3-node core, single-param)
meta.description: Core collection loop: collect_invoice -> collect_amount -> confirm. Each node has ONE single-param function (submit_invoice / submit_amount / confirm_payment), so there are no shared function definitions. Terminal outcomes (retries_exhausted -> terminate, confirmed -> success, cancelled -> goodbye, payment_failed -> api_failure) are omitted here — add those nodes in the UI and point the outcomes at them. Handler bodies (lookup, limits, retry budgets) live in payment_editor.py and are opaque to the canvas.

global_functions.name: get_business_info
global_functions.description: Answer a general question (hours, contact, what an invoice number is). Stays in the current node.

role_messages.content: You are Marissa, an automated payments assistant. Be brief and warm. Convert spoken numbers to digits. Never invent a value the caller did not provide.

task_messages.content: Get the invoice number (3-10 digits) and call submit_invoice(invoice_number=...). Ask ONLY for the invoice number here; the amount is collected at the next step.

pre_actions.fallback: Welcome to the payments line. May I have your invoice number please?

functions.name: submit_invoice
functions.description: Record the invoice number, look it up, and move to the amount step. Validation, lookup and retry budget are handled in payment_editor.py.

decision.action: # result is computed by submit_invoice() in payment_editor.py: found | invalid_invoice | invoice_not_found | retries_exhausted

role_messages.content: You are Marissa, an automated payments assistant. Be brief and warm.

task_messages.content: The invoice is already recorded. Get the amount in pounds and call submit_amount(amount=...).

pre_actions.fallback: How much would you like to pay?

functions.name: submit_amount
functions.description: Record the amount to pay and move to confirmation. Limits and retry budget are handled in payment_editor.py.

decision.action: # result is computed by submit_amount() in payment_editor.py: ready_to_confirm | amount_out_of_range | retries_exhausted

role_messages.content: You are Marissa. Respond only by calling a function. Never say the payment is done - the next node speaks the result.

task_messages.content: Handle the yes/no read-back reply. Yes -> confirm_payment(confirmed=true). Change the amount -> confirm_payment(confirmed=false). Cancel -> confirm_payment(confirmed=false, cancel=true).

functions.name: confirm_payment
functions.description: Finalize or cancel the payment after the read-back.

confirmed.description: True if confirmed as read back.

decision.action: # result is computed by confirm_payment() in payment_editor.py: confirmed | cancelled | payment_failed | not_confirmed. Add success/goodbye/api_failure nodes in the UI and point confirmed/cancelled/payment_failed at them.

post_actions.text: I will terminate the call, bye.
